findings.title: Order total recomputed after discount is applied
findings.description: The subtotal is recalculated from the cart after the discount has already been subtracted, so the discount is effectively lost on the final total.
findings.fix: Recompute the subtotal before applying the discount, or apply the discount to the already-final total instead of recomputing.

findings.title: Payment captured before order is persisted
findings.description: capture_payment() runs before the order row is committed, so a crash between the two leaves a charged customer with no order record.
findings.fix: Persist the order first, then capture payment, or wrap both in a saga with compensation.

findings.title: Discount code validated only on the client
findings.description: The discount code format is checked in the UI but the server trusts whatever code arrives in the request body.
findings.fix: Re-validate the discount code format and eligibility server-side before applying it.

findings.title: Silent except around database write
findings.description: A bare except swallows any error raised while writing the order row, so failed writes look like successes to the caller.
findings.fix: Catch the specific database exception, log it, and re-raise or return an explicit failure.

findings.title: Timezone-naive datetime used for invoice due date
findings.description: datetime.now() without a timezone is used to compute the invoice due date, which drifts depending on server locale.
findings.fix: Use an explicit UTC-aware datetime and convert to the customer's timezone only for display.

findings.title: Order status transition skips validation
findings.description: set_status() writes the new status directly without checking that the transition is legal from the current status.
findings.fix: Route every status change through the state machine's transition table.

findings.title: Unused import of legacy pricing module
findings.description: legacy_pricing is imported but never referenced in this file.

findings.title: Magic number for retry count
findings.description: The retry loop hardcodes 3 with no named constant or comment explaining the choice.

findings.title: Query built with string concatenation
findings.description: The filter clause is built with string concatenation instead of the query builder's parameter binding.

findings.title: Function exceeds 80 lines
findings.description: apply_checkout() has grown past 80 lines and mixes pricing, inventory, and notification concerns.

findings.title: Mutable default argument on Order constructor
findings.description: Order.__init__ defaults items to a list literal, which is shared across every instance created without an explicit items argument.

findings.title: Docstring missing for public function
findings.description: apply_checkout() is part of the public API but has no docstring.
